query: authoritative sources design-loop uses to teach INTERACTION (behaviour, flows, usability)
audience: a dev/PM becoming an IC product designer
job: make a screen behave the way the user models the task

items.name: The Design of Everyday Things (Norman, 2013)
items.covers: affordances, signifiers, mapping, feedback — the conceptual floor
items.wins_when: you need shared vocabulary for why a control is (un)usable

items.name: About Face 4e (Cooper et al., 2014)
items.wins_when: you are structuring behaviour, not just a screen

items.name: Don't Make Me Think, Revisited (Krug, 2014)
items.wins_when: you need a fast usability read

items.name: Designing Interfaces 3e (Tidwell, Brewer & Valencia, O'Reilly 2020)
items.wins_when: you want reusable interaction patterns, not just methodology
